A tavern where nobody leaves hungry

Terry's Place is a small restaurant in a side street off the seafront road in Limassol, with white chairs, white tablecloths and a bar lit in purple. Guests describe it as a tavern for locals rather than tourists. The octopus is the dish most people mention, and guests also praise the mussels in garlic sauce, the sea bass and the moussaka. Many reviews tell the same story: a big salad and bread come first, the portions are large, and at the end there is a fruit plate and ice cream. The menu on the street is written in Greek, Russian, Finnish and English.

Open every day except Tuesday, 11:00 to 22:00. Special offers such as octopus or mussels come with a glass of wine of your choice.

What guests say

Four of 1,254 Google reviews, 4.8 stars on average.

“Came here for dinner twice and we loved it. The garlic sauce served with mussels was scrumptious. I also appreciate that a small bottle of wine, water, a salad, bread, a fruit platter and an ice cream was included in the price. It was an unbeatable deal!!!”

“We had a wonderful sea bream with fresh salad today. Very tasty, served with a smile, the atmosphere is of a tavern for locals, not touristy, and the price was unbelievable for the quality of the food. Will definitely come back.”
